xl: inferred: integer in [-8192, 57344), tested before a coordinate goes into the Set field `packed`
Bl: result is added to and looked up in the Set field `packed`: `(x + 8192) * 65536 + (y + 8192)`; inferred otherwise
Wl: held in the field `lookup` of the cache the scene stores as `walkableLookup` (`walkableLookup.get(walkableTiles).has(x, y)`); built from `walkableTiles`
Rl: scene field `walkableLookup: new Rl()`; fields `lookup`, `source`, `size`, `rebuilds`; rebuilds its `lookup` when the source set changes: "Cache" is inferred
Pl: assigned in `setArenaConfig` with the keys `bounds`, `walkableTiles`, `collisionMap`; read by `getArenaBounds` and `getArenaCollisionMap`
Fl: `Fl.get(walkableTiles).has(x, y)` in `isArenaTileWalkable`; the same class the scene keeps under `walkableLookup`
$l: engine/replay.js: `const savedArenaConfig = aU()`, restored with `setArenaConfig(savedArenaConfig, savedArenaDefaultWalkable)`; returns a copy `{ bounds, walkableTiles, collisionMap }` of the current config
Zl: Map written by `oe(kind, arena)` and read by `Yl(kind)`, whose result the engine names `registeredArenaConfig`
oe: tools/determinism/harness.mjs: "register it under the encounter's kind, where the engine looks for it" (`rendering.oe(descriptor.kind, arena)`); `Zl.set(kind, arena)`

fM: inferred: walks the tiles between two points and fails on `CollisionFlag.BLOCK_*_PROJECTILE` flags; playerAttack/launch.js: `withinRicochetRange && X(fromX, fromY, toX, toY)`
uM: inferred: returns the value limited to [min, max]; `vM` uses it to pick the nearest tile of each rectangle for the line-of-sight test
vM: inferred: the test behind `isFootprintInAttackRange`, on two rectangles given as min/max coordinates, with the `attackRange`, `checkCollision` and `meleeReach` options
pM: inferred: `vM` from one tile (x, y) to a square footprint with `checkCollision` fixed to true; playerMovement.js stops pathing towards an NPC when it holds
SM: inferred: SimulationEngine and playerAttack/launch.js: `aT(player.position, targetNpc.position, targetNpc.size, effectiveRange, true, effectiveReach)`; sibling of `isFootprintInAttackRange`
bM: SimulationEngine: `const isUnderTarget = l(player.position, targetNpc.position, targetNpc.size)`; inferred otherwise
yM: inferred: the test of isTileInsideFootprint on plain coordinates (x, y, footprintX, footprintY, size); the name says point so that it is not mistaken for isTileInFootprint of npcRoutes.js, a third copy of the test with another argument order
zM: inferred: for two tiles one cardinal step apart, tests `CollisionFlag.WALL_EAST` on one and `WALL_WEST` on the other (and so on per direction)

EH: inferred: `tick < debuffs.boundUntilTick + 5`; specialAttacks.js skips the "freeze" and on-hit "bind" effects when it holds
GH: reads `healthBarWhenUntargetable`, else `NH` (targetable); the overlay that draws health bars and hitsplats skips an NPC when it is false
UH: inferred: targetable and past `attackBlockedUntilTick`; playerAttack/launch.js filters area targets and drops the player's attack target with it
qH: inferred: `world.actors.get(actor.id) === actor`; the engine returns from an NPC's turn when it is false (`if (!H(this.worldState, npc)) return`)
eM: returns `lifeGeneration ?? 0` for an NPC, 0 otherwise; CombatSystem stores it as `sourceLife` and `targetLife`
aM: error string "NPC '...' already has a death record for this life"; creates `{ status: "pending", killTick, processTick, causeStage }` under `death`
tM: inferred: moves `death.processTick` of a pending "hit-queue" death back to its `killTick`; CombatSystem calls it when another hit landed, or is still queued, on the NPC after the lethal one
sM: sets `death.animationNotified = true` when the animation is due and returns whether it did; guards `onDeathAnimation` in npcDefinitions.js
rM: `death.status === "started"` and `deathAnimationTick === tick`; SimulationEngine then asks `npcDefinitions.releaseOnDeathAnimation`, CombatSystem.tryLaunchDeathAnimationAttack requires it
oM: writes `lastStepTick`; SimulationEngine.applyNpcMovementRequest calls it when the NPC moved
mM: SimulationEngine.removeDeadNpcs: `const despawnTick = ai(npc)`; returns `despawnTick`, held back to `deathAnimationTick` for a queued death
SG: reads and advances `hitpointRegenNextTick`, then `vitals.hp++`; sibling of `scheduleNpcHitpointRegen`; the engine calls it after applyBurnPulse and applyPoisonPulse

MM: inferred: packs (x, y) into the number kept in the Set field `flags` of the occupancy class
IM: WorldState: `this.occupancy = new bf()`; argument of `createOccupancyStepCheck`; "Map" is inferred (methods isBlocked, add, remove, step)

hf: keyed by prayer name (Piety, Rigour, Augury, ...), each entry a partial of `neutralPrayerMultipliers`; read by `getPrayerMultipliers`
BM: inferred: floor(levels.attack x prayer attack multiplier) + stance bonus + 8, x 1.1 for `voidSet === "melee"`; multiplied by (attack bonus + 64) to give `attackRoll`
WM: inferred: 3 for stance "Defensive" or "Longrange", 1 for "Controlled", added to the defence level in `getPlayerDefenceRoll`
_M: playerAttack/plan.js: `case "double_roll": return bh(attackRoll, defenceRoll)` and `case "doubleRoll"`; sibling of `getSingleRollHitChance`
EM: playerAttack/plan.js: `const accuracyRolls = az(attackSetup.attacker, attackSetup.target, ...)`; returns `{ attackRoll, defenceRoll, chance }`; the attack roll uses the player's `stance` and `voidSet`
jM: stored under `defenceRoll`; reads the NPC's `defensive` bonuses and `toaRaidLevel`; sibling of `getPlayerDefenceRoll` and `getNpcAttackRoll`
VM: inferred: floor((effective level x (strength bonus + 64) + 320) / 640), the value `getFormulaMaxHit` returns
vT: stored under `stance` in `getPlayerFormulaStats` and in playerAttack/plan.js; reads the selected style's `combatStyle`

KM: playerAttack/launch.js stores the result in `impactDelayTicks`, SimulationEngine in `delay`, beside `spell.fixedHitDelay` and `hitDelayTicks`; cases "melee", "bow", "thrown", "magic", "magic_slow" by distance
qM: entries `{ delay, lengthAdjustment, stepMultiplier, progress }` are what `getProjectileFlightCycles` takes; playerAttack/launch.js names the same shape `weaponProjectileTiming`, npcHelpers.js reads it from `timing`
YM: playerAttack/launch.js: `impactDelayTicks = av(getProjectileFlightCycles(...))`; 1 + floor(cycles / 30), one more than `getTicksFromCycles`

uT: decision sites "npc.attack.accuracy" and "npc.attack.damage"; returns `{ accuracy, accuracySucceeded, maxHit, rolledDamage }`
kT: inferred: `getTicksFromCycles(getProjectileFlightCycles(timing, distance))`, added to `impactDelayTicks` when the plan has a `projectile`

LT: chosen for the step (-1, 0) in `BT`; `single: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_WEST`
DT: chosen for the step (1, 0) in `BT`; `single: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_EAST`
HT: chosen for the step (0, -1) in `BT`; `single: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_SOUTH`
MT: chosen for the step (0, 1) in `BT`; `single: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_NORTH`
TT: chosen for the step (-1, -1) in `WT`; `corner: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_SOUTH_WEST`
IT: chosen for the step (-1, 1) in `WT`; `corner: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_NORTH_WEST`
CT: chosen for the step (1, -1) in `WT`; `corner: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_SOUTH_EAST`
xT: chosen for the step (1, 1) in `WT`; `corner: CollisionFlag.BLOCK_NORTH_EAST`
BT: inferred: the cardinal half of `canFootprintStepInArena`: walkable tiles and collision flags along the leading edge of the destination footprint
WT: inferred: the diagonal half of `canFootprintStepInArena` (`corner`, `horizontalStrip`, `verticalStrip`, `xIntermediate`, `yIntermediate` masks)

MO: inferred: 128, the side of the search grid centred on the route's `source`; playerMovement.js has the same value as `gridSize`
TO: inferred: 16384 = 128 x 128, the length of the `parents`, distance and queue arrays
IO: entries `{ deltaX, deltaY }`: the four cardinal steps, then the four diagonal ones
CO: inferred: how far a coordinate lies outside [min, max], 0 when inside
BO: inferred: the x and y distances from the tile to the footprint add up to 1; the goal test of the "melee" route
WO: inferred: `x * 128 + y`; the result is stored as `startIndex` and indexes `parents`
RO: result is returned under `steps`; walks `parents` back to `startIndex`

VL: inferred: returns the `{ name, styles }` entry of the table keyed by weapon category (`_L[getWeaponCategory(id)]`, falling back to `_L.unarmed`); callers read `.styles[selectedAttackStyleIndex]`, and Grid.js shows its `.name` after the label "Category: "
